title: Titanium Liquid Level Float
function: Hollow ball float switch for chemical tank
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Liquid Level Float where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Hollow ball float switch for chemical tank requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by hollow ball float switch for chemical tank and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for hollow ball float application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (hollow ball verified)
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife — critical for hollow ball float performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Liquid Level Float resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Liquid Level Float resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for hollow ball float.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Liquid Level Float orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Liquid Level Float is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Liquid Level Float?
faq.a: Each Titanium Liquid Level Float shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for hollow ball float.
